prescribedGeometry.description: Exact centered SD3 five-coordinate initialization continued linearly with the ledger's declared member velocities for prescribed display only; no EOM evolution, return, retention, stability, or physical realization is implied.

choices: The position and velocity at T=0 are the immutable measured sample from the exact five-coordinate initialization ledger.
Each individually identified worldline uses the simplest centered linear continuation of that exact position and velocity.
The continuation is nonperiodic and is not an EOM-solver trajectory or a return claim.
